provider.name: BacDive
provider.organization_type: bacterial and archaeal strain phenotypic, taxonomic, genomic, and cultivation database
provider.description: BacDive is a strain-level database for bacteria and archaea that integrates taxonomy, culture collection identifiers, morphology, physiology, metabolism, cultivation, isolation, environmental, genomic, sequence, safety, and literature-linked information.
institutional_context: Leibniz Institute DSMZ – German Collection of Microorganisms and Cell Cultures
DSMZ culture collections and microbial bioresource infrastructure

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting BacDive documentation, strain-data definitions, API and account guidance, downloads, cultivation and phenotype documentation, legal terms, citation instructions, and DSMZ institutional context.
purpose.authoritative_notice: BacDive and DSMZ remain authoritative for strain records, identifiers, schema definitions, API behavior, downloads, citation, rights, legal terms, and contact information.

review.notes: Primary BacDive website and documentation discovery root.
Project purpose, history, scope, partners, funding, and institutional context.
Official contact details, editorial support, data corrections, and technical assistance.
Search interface for strains, taxonomy, identifiers, phenotype, origin, and collection numbers.
Advanced search forms, searchable fields, filters, query semantics, and export options.
Representative strain record pages and detailed field structure; avoid exhaustive crawling.
Discovery seed for taxonomic classification, accepted names, synonyms, and lineage fields.
Bulk files, export formats, data packages, metadata, and access conditions.
Programmatic API root, authentication, endpoints, query syntax, examples, and response schemas.
Developer documentation, endpoint reference, authentication, pagination, limits, and examples.
Account creation, authentication workflow, credentials, and token handling.
User documentation, schema explanations, search instructions, and field definitions.
User guide, tutorials, search help, field interpretation, and troubleshooting.
Frequently asked questions about data, access, accounts, APIs, and citation.
Discovery seed for data sections, field names, definitions, controlled vocabularies, and provenance.
Primary papers, database updates, methods, data papers, and recommended citations.
Preferred citation, version, access date, DOI, and attribution requirements.
Discovery seed for database license, reuse, redistribution, attribution, and commercial-use conditions.
Terms of use, acceptable use, disclaimers, database access, and account conditions.
Privacy, cookies, analytics, registration, API accounts, and personal-data processing.
Project announcements, releases, database updates, and service changes.
Parent-institution overview, legal identity, collections, services, and contact information.
Culture collection context, strain deposits, accession numbers, availability, and biosafety information.
Parent-institution legal identity and website terms; verify applicability to BacDive.
Parent-institution privacy policy; verify applicability to BacDive.
Crawler access rules; evaluate before recursive acquisition.
Crawler policy for API documentation host.
Optional machine-readable URL discovery source; may not exist or may redirect.

notes: Verify the current API base URL, documentation path, and account requirements.
Do not store credentials or API tokens in this manifest.
Capture endpoint families, request parameters, authentication, pagination, response schemas, limits, examples, and legal conditions.
Capture exact official legal wording before normalizing rights metadata.
Separate BacDive-curated strain data from culture collection records, publications, and external accession databases.
API access, bulk downloads, and website browsing may have distinct terms.
Do not assume DSMZ website terms fully describe BacDive database licensing.
Seed URLs are best-effort and were not live-verified in this session.
The acquisition program should update retrieval, content, review, and verification fields in place.
Some paths may redirect, be renamed, require accounts, or be unavailable; preserve redirect and failure metadata.
Do not recursively crawl every strain record when the task is documentation acquisition.
Do not store API keys, passwords, cookies, OAuth tokens, or session credentials in this JSON file.
BacDive-curated fields, DSMZ collection data, third-party accessions, publications, downloads, and APIs may carry different rights.
